newsitem.title: USA: Duane Reade Holding sees $380 mln in 1996 sales.
newsitem.headline: Duane Reade Holding sees $380 mln in 1996 sales.

text.p: Duane Reade Holding Corp said Tuesday it expected sales for its fiscal year, ended Dec 28, to be about $380 million.
The company said that it expected earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization and other non-cash charges (EBITDA) to be about $35 million, or 9.2 percent of sales.

The company also said it is evaluating a number of financing alternatives including a potential initial public offering. The company said it intends to initiate discussions with its bond holders to review financing alternatives.
In other matters, the company said it has named William Tennant as the company's new chief financial officer. He was previously chief financial officer at Tops Appliance City Inc.
Duane Reade is a retailer with 60 drug stores in metropolitan New York City.
